# Who may call what. Generated by EndpointRolesTest and compared with it on
# every build, so adding an endpoint or changing its roles fails until this file
# is updated in the same commit -- where the diff shows exactly what moved.
#
# The roles come from the named annotations in com.skillbridge.common.security
# (@CollegeAdminOnly and the rest). NONE means the endpoint narrows by no role:
# SecurityConfig still decides, and everything outside its permitAll list
# (/auth/**, /colleges/active) needs a signed-in caller.
#
# To update after a deliberate change:
#   cp skillbridge-backend/target/endpoint-roles.actual.txt \
#      skillbridge-backend/src/test/resources/endpoint-roles.txt
DELETE  /api/v1/admin/batches/{batchId}/enrollments/{studentId}          COLLEGE_ADMIN,SYSTEM_ADMIN
